description: A small brown cardboard box sits on the table in front of you, with a white item tucked inside. The left hand slides in toward the box as the right hand comes in from the right; the box becomes a two-hand object as both hands steady it and the right hand lifts the lid open, then the right hand reaches into the open box to grasp the white item as a right-hand object and pulls it out to the right, leaving the box open while the left hand relaxes nearby.
